reuse.why: Parameterises the existing getMonthActionCategories helper for five actions, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own row-level exclusion chain and gets the flag added there instead of reusing the helper's selection.

duplication.why: The hidden/hidden-group rule and its new opt-out now live in two places, the helper's SQL and copyPreviousMonth's inline check, and the same flag destructuring is added to six signatures.

placement.why: The flag is applied in the shared selection helper in budget/actions.ts, which is the right layer; copyPreviousMonth's local exclusion remains a parallel rule site.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing, the helper and tests; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: A further change to which categories month-wide actions fill must still be made in both the helper and copyPreviousMonth, and the SQL is assembled by string interpolation of a filter fragment.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts decides hidden/hidden-group (and #fixed, templates) itself instead of using getMonthActionCategories; the diff extends that local check with the new flag.

disguised_duplication.where: The parallel hidden check in copyPreviousMonth is plainly visible, not reshaped.
